text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from shopping for supplies 
with Shinko Windy, a child came running up 
to us.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! It's Windy-chan! Windy-chan, shake 
my hand!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hm? Who the heck are you?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
You know, I want to become a villain just 
like Windy-chan!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
"If I don't wanna do it, I won't; I only 
do what I want! That is what being evil is 
all about!" That was so cool!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oho...!! Wahahaha, I see, I see! I like 
you! I'm making you Windy-chan's minion!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Then maybe I can beat justice too? 
Evil always loses, but... If it's 
Windy-chan, can I win!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally! Leave it to the boss! I'll 
show you how a winner does it!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Mmm~~, how should I show off a cool 
victory for evil...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You seem to be in trouble, my dear buddy! 
If something's bothering you, won't you 
tell me about it?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Pearl-senpai! Or rather... Dangerous 
Beauty Mask!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...And that's why I'm gonna defeat 
justice! I want my underlings to see what 
a cool boss looks like!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's a great goal, Windy! 
However... is just winning really enough?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hm...? What does that mean, nanoda?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Is an evil victory all that should be 
shown? I wonder if my henchmen would be 
satisfied with that.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That henchman is your fan, isn't she, 
Windy?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...What my henchmen want to see...

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
"If I don't wanna do it, I won't; I only 
do what I want! That is what being evil is 
all about!" That was so cool!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I see...! So that's how it is...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, seems they've noticed. Windy, show 
them the glorious figure of the Big Boss 
they admire so much!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I want Pearl-senpai to help out too, 
indeed!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
—On our next day off, I'm holding a 
"Villain Show"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later. The villain show began 
with our minions invited. Shinko Windy 
took the lead role as the Demon King. I 
was also roped in to play the hero of 
justice—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"So you've shown yourself, Mask of 
Justice! Demon Lord Windy-sama will crush 
you!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Demon King, leave it to me! I'll 
beat that fellow black and blue!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! W-Why...!? Forgiving me, an 
executive officer... is that what you're 
saying...?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If... that's permitted. ...Then I want to 
start over from scratch!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Lord Demon King... no, Windy! You come 
along too..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —Don't mess with me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If you want to betray me, go right ahead! 
However! The Demon King never reforms!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Even if I end up completely alone! No 
matter what anyone says! I'll do what I 
want all the way to the end...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"That's what evil is! Evil will NEVER give 
in to justice!"

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: B-Boss! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph! Henchman, watch closely...! 
This... THIS is the Great Demon King 
Windy-!

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Evil won! And Boss, you looked so 
super cool! Fighting on all by yourself 
without giving up!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gahaha! Villains are so cool, right?! You 
admire Windy-chan even more now, 
don'tcha~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, you. Well done. Thanks to you, the 
villain show was a huge hit.
choice_data_list:
Good for you, gaining such dedicated 
henchmen!

Aren't you glad you got such enthusiastic 
underlings?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, you. Well done. Thanks to you, the 
villain show was a huge hit.
choice_data_list:
Good for you, gaining such dedicated 
henchmen!

Aren't you glad you got such enthusiastic 
underlings?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? What are you talking about!? 
Working hard for one's henchmen is only 
natural for a boss!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Why would I do anything good?! Evil only 
does bad things!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy was able to show off her cool 
side to her underling during the villain 
show. Her minion will undoubtedly keep 
supporting the Boss from now on.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Fufun! Of course I am!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
My minion actually shows some decent 
promise! Someday you'll make quite the 
villain! Wahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy demonstrated what it truly 
means to be a villain. Her underling 
surely understood the importance of 
staying true to oneself.
